projectDescription: A high-performance Windows IOCP C++ game server with an ASP.NET Core auth service and Unreal Engine 5 client, implementing real-time TCP/UDP multiplayer, Area of Interest management, inventory persistence, monster AI, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
keyFeatures: Windows IOCP (I/O Completion Port) TCP server supporting up to 10,000 concurrent sessions
Hybrid TCP + UDP transport: reliable packets over TCP, low-latency movement over UDP
ASP.NET Core AuthServer with PBKDF2 password hashing, JWT-style tokens in Redis
Area of Interest (AoI) cell grid for efficient player/monster visibility culling
Server-authoritative movement replication with client-side prediction support
Inventory persistence with optimistic concurrency (revision-based) backed by MariaDB
Character state persistence with bucketed async saves
Prometheus metrics endpoint + Grafana dashboard for real-time monitoring
MoveLoadTester C# tool for multi-client movement load testing
PerformanceReport tool for CSV/HTML analysis of load test results
publicApiSurface: POST /auth/login — authenticate and receive an access token
POST /auth/select-server — exchange access token for an enter token + game server IP/port
TCP PacketId 0x0201 C_EnterGameReq — enter game session with enter token
TCP PacketId 0x0204 C_UdpHelloReq — register UDP endpoint
UDP PacketId 0x0211 C_MoveReq — send movement input
TCP PacketId 0x0221 C_ChatReq — send chat message
TCP PacketId 0x0231 C_AttackReq — send attack command
TCP PacketId 0x0252 C_InventoryMoveReq — move inventory item
TCP PacketId 0x0254 C_InventoryUseReq — use inventory item
